t: This is Holy Trinity, a Church of England church in Castelnau, Barnes. It was designed by Thomas Allom, an English architect, artist and topographical illustrator who was a founding member of what became the Royal Institute of British Architects. Allom also designed St Peter's in Notting Hill and parts of the Ladbroke Estate there. He worked with Sir Charles Barry on the Houses of Parliament too, and he published illustrated books on Constantinople and on China.
